Max Win
- The maximum win amount is limited to 2,015x bet. If
the total win of a round reaches 2,015x bet the round
immediately ends, win is awarded and all remaining
features are forfeited.
 Buy Feature
 - The feature can be instantly triggered from the base
 game by buying it for 100x current total bet. The bought
 - feature will start after all tumbles and spin features
 of the base game spin that triggered it end.
 - To advance through the levels in a bought SUPER
 FEVER round collect winning symbols as follows:
 o Level 2 - Collect 116 winning symbols. Level 2 plays
 with 4x win multiplier.
 o Level 3 - Collect 121 winning symbols. Level 3 plays
 with 6x win multiplier.
 o Level 4 - Collect 129 winning symbols. Level 4 plays
 with 8x win multiplier.
 o Level 5 - Collect 138 winning symbols. Level 5 plays
 with 10x win multiplier.

PRAGMATIC PLAY

 GAME OVERVIEW
  GAME OVERVIEW: BOMB BONANZA

Game Description
(for Players)
There’s gold in those hills!

Pick up your shovel and get digging with the lucky miner as you delve
underground into his goldmine which is home to 5×5 reels and symbols
depicting Pickaxes, Gold Pans, Wild Bombs and more.

Three free spin symbols are key to unlocking six free spins. Here players
will be collecting as much gold as possible to upgrade the wild bombs,
awarding extra free spins and expanding the bombs into different-
sized patterns.

These extra wilds help in winning the treasures hidden within the mine
and unlocking Bomb Bonanza™’s max win of 2,015x!
